title: Ruppelt's account of early UFO hypotheses

tellings.quote: And if you read Ruppelt's book on you know, the unexplained stuff that was going on then, he talks through how they go through all these hypotheses. It's like, is it human? Could it be Russian? Could it somehow be Nazi technology?

plain: In the early years of UFO sightings after 1947, US officials worked through a list of explanations: were the objects human, Russian, or somehow Nazi technology? That is how the researcher Jason Simosa sums up the book written by Edward J. Ruppelt, an Air Force officer who studied the reports in that period. He brings it up to show how seriously the government once weighed who might be behind the objects.
